title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing agrees with the Worldwide roadmap item and Microsoft's updated notice, including the preview and rollout windows. The licensing, Azure storage costs and role-assignment controls are supported; unpublished details are appropriately distinguished from the existing Purview import service.

claims.claim: There is an existing PST import service in the Microsoft Purview portal distinct from the planned PowerShell-only route.
claims.quote: Use the Import service in the Microsoft Purview portal to quickly bulk-import PST files to Exchange Online mailboxes in your organization.

claims.claim: The existing Purview import service supports network upload.
claims.quote: Network upload: Upload the PST files over the network to a temporary Azure Storage location in the Microsoft cloud.

claims.claim: The existing Purview import service supports drive shipping.
claims.quote: Drive shipping: Copy the PST files to a BitLocker-encrypted hard drive and then physically ship the drive to Microsoft.

claims.claim: The existing service documents creation of an import job on the Import PST files page.
claims.quote: Create a PST import job on the Import PST files page in the Microsoft Purview portal and submit the PST import mapping file you created in the previous step.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has not documented which cmdlets implement this Azure PST Import workflow.
claims.quote: Searched: "Azure PST Import" license pricing roles cmdlets Analyze migration batch; "Azure PST Import" "PowerShell" "roles". Read New-MigrationEndpoint and New-MailboxImportRequest excerpts; neither documents this new workflow.

claims.claim: The New-MigrationEndpoint reference documents -PSTImport as on-premises only.
claims.quote:
### -PSTImport

This parameter is available only in on-premises Exchange.

claims.claim: The documented -PSTImport parameter is reserved for internal Microsoft use, not a published control for the planned feature.
claims.quote: This parameter is reserved for internal Microsoft use.

claims.claim: The detailed batch input file formats for Azure PST Import remain undocumented beyond the notice's XML and/or CSV description.
claims.quote: Searched: "Azure PST Import" "XML" "CSV". Read results from pst-import-overview, pst-import-network-upload and pst-import-drive-shipping; they describe the existing portal mapping CSV, not this workflow's schemas.

claims.claim: Whether Azure PST Import automatically enables retention hold is not established by the available documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: "Azure PST Import" "retention" "20". Opened pst-import-overview and read network-upload and drive-shipping excerpts; retention hold is described for existing Purview import, not the new PowerShell-only route.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import turns on retention hold for imported mailboxes.
claims.quote: After you import PST files to a Microsoft 365 mailbox, the retention hold setting for the mailbox is turned on indefinitely.

claims.claim: Retention settings can permanently delete old imported messages without retention hold.
claims.quote: If messages you import to a mailbox are old, the retention settings configured for the mailbox might cause those messages to be permanently deleted (purged).

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import recommends PST files no larger than 20 GB.
claims.quote: Upload or copy PST files that are no larger than 20 GB. Large PST files can affect the performance of the import process.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import skips mailbox items larger than 150 MB.
claims.quote: If a PST file contains a mailbox item that's larger than 150 MB, the import process skips the item and doesn't import it.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import cannot import more than 100 GB into a user's archive in a single import.
claims.quote: you can't import more than 100 GB of data into a user's archive in a single import.

claims.where: Open questions: applicability of existing guidance and limits
claims.claim: Whether the existing Purview import's size guidance and item and archive limits apply to Azure PST Import remains unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Searched: "Azure PST Import" "retention" "20"; "Azure PST Import". Read pst-import-overview and network-upload excerpts; their limits concern the existing two portal methods. MC1281505 names quota and file-size validation but gives no numeric limits.
